prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock with perfectly clean cut edges — no outline, no bright edge line of any kind. Each object is a stack of completely flat die-cut pieces. Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: straight shapes are cut straight, curves only where the real object is curved, corners may be gently rounded. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. This is one DRAMATIC COMIC ACTION PANEL filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge (full-bleed, no border): a bold dynamic diagonal composition, extreme close-up staging, big flat paper SPEED-LINE strips radiating from the impact point, one or two flat paper starburst shapes. Exaggerated, funny, kid-friendly cartoon action — never scary, no blood, no sharp fangs. The tiger is a cute chubby Korean folk-tale tiger cub: flat persimmon-orange paper body with separate dark-brown stripe pieces, cream muzzle and belly patch, BIG round white paper eyes with dark pupils, small pink cheek circles, small rounded ears. Palette: deep indigo night backdrop hints, warm amber kitchen light, persimmon orange, straw gold, cream. The tiger has dipped his FACE into the open mouth of a big brown clay water jar to wash his sore eye; a cute green paper soft-shell turtle pops up from the water and CHOMPS onto the tiger's MOUTH (his upper lip and nose), extreme close-up on the tiger's face and the jar rim, flat paper water splash pieces flying, the tiger's eyes wide with surprise. The turtle bites the tiger's MOUTH, not a paw. No text anywhere. Full-bleed illustration, no lime green.
